findings.area: pair, treasury, vault and signer authority
findings.finding: Pool eligibility accepts any truthy pairAddress, treasuryAuthorization, vaultAddress, secureSigner and receiptVerifier. The passing tests use the non-address strings 0xpair and 0xvault and bare true booleans.
findings.impact: Caller fixtures can manufacture pair verification, treasury authority, custody, signer binding and receipt-verifier facts.
findings.disposition: HOLD; require canonical chain, factory, token, code, deployment, treasury, custody and signer manifests plus independently verified receipts.

findings.finding: The snapshot has no chain ID, factory, token0/token1, pair code hash, reserves, decimals, block, timestamp, freshness, oracle or depth-source binding. Missing priceImpactBps defaults to zero, while self-match and wash-trade absence defaults to safe.
findings.impact: Stale, fabricated or unrelated market data can be treated as a low-impact, non-manipulated eligible pool.
findings.disposition: HOLD; use trusted fresh reserve and price evidence and fail closed on every missing risk field.

findings.finding: Depth target, current depth, daily cap and price impact are not validated as non-negative bigint values or bound to asset units. The proposal has no quote amount, minimum amounts, slippage enforcement, deadline, allowance lifecycle, fee-on-transfer/rebase handling or reserve-ratio invariant.
findings.impact: Malformed, negative, mismatched-unit or economically unsafe proposals can be emitted even though the planner labels the pool eligible.
findings.disposition: HOLD; define typed units, checked arithmetic and complete AMM execution parameters before any successor.

findings.finding: The dailyCap is caller-provided per call and is never reserved or consumed in durable state. Budget allocation may leave integer-division dust and accepts unverified or missing quote budgets without rates, decimals, provenance or atomic reservation.
findings.impact: Concurrent or repeated calls can each propose the full cap, over-allocate treasury intent, lose dust and diverge from quote-side funding.
findings.disposition: HOLD; require a durable transactional budget ledger, replay keys, locking, idempotency and receipt reconciliation.

findings.finding: LP fees, impermanent loss, gas, funding cost and realizedNetProfit are caller-provided bigint values. There is no LP-token balance, fee receipt, mark source, time window, realization event, funding liability or accounting-ledger binding.
findings.impact: A caller can manufacture profitable performance and a 70/30 treasury-return proposal without realized, settled or attributable value.
findings.disposition: HOLD; retain proposal-only status and require receipt-bound double-entry accounting.

findings.finding: The 60/35/5 pool split, 300-bps impact limit and 70/30 return policy are branch-local constants with no current Canon or Human approval. The branch creates a second Auto-LP runtime instead of integrating the current AI_ANT_AUTO_LP architecture, existing K18921 prototype/game lineage, pair registry and accounting boundaries.
findings.impact: Merging would create competing liquidity policy and runtime truth and could be mistaken for treasury or execution authority.
findings.disposition: HOLD; a successor must be current-main based, policy-approved and integrated with the existing non-executable Auto-LP architecture.

findings.finding: The module plans only addition. It defines no LP removal, depeg response, oracle divergence, impermanent-loss limit, emergency stop, vault recovery, custody acceptance, approval revocation, position ownership proof or liquidation/withdrawal path.
findings.impact: Any later execution integration could lock assets or continue adding risk without a safe exit and recovery lifecycle.
findings.disposition: HOLD; define and independently review the complete position lifecycle before any liquidity movement.

findings.finding: The exact head has no GitHub Actions run, commit status or review. Its eight local tests pass but exercise only the caller-fixture model and do not test replay, concurrency, stale evidence, address/code identity, receipt inclusion, custody, accounting or emergency exits.
findings.impact: The branch has no exact-head CI evidence for the security and integration properties required by real liquidity infrastructure.
findings.disposition: HOLD; do not merge the original PR.
